files_created_or_modified.summary: Added PauseMissionResponse schema; added wait_reason, recovery_required, is_paused to MissionSnapshot.
Added MISSION_PAUSED event emission in request_pause(); added MISSION_RESUMED emission in resume_mission().
Added POST /api/missions/{mission_id}/pause; added in-flight live unpause branch in /resume; updated snapshot with wait_reason, recovery_required, is_paused.
Populate state.mission.workspace_root from payload on MISSION_STARTED.
Added PauseMissionResponse interface; added wait_reason, recovery_required, is_paused fields to MissionSnapshot.
Added HermesApiClient.pauseMission(); added sequence gap detection in connectMissionEvents().
Enhanced mission status badge to report PAUSED and WAITING reasons accurately.
Added Pause, Resume, and Stop controls; added disabled in-flight guards; added waiting/paused placeholder status.
Added Execution Waiting / Recovery diagnosis card; added Pause, Resume, Stop buttons with in-flight guards.
Integrated handlePauseMission, handleResumeMission, gap resync trigger, in-flight flags, and immutable mission workspace display.
Isolated test database fixture to prevent fallback to global disk state.
Dedicated 8-scenario acceptance suite for Phase 8 integration.
